objective: Produce a status/handoff that can resume after a separate chat without relying on conversation history alone.
scenario: A project has current stage, artifacts, approved decisions, unknowns and next action.
expected_behaviors: Include project identifier/revision/date, mode/stage, completed work and artifact IDs.
Distinguish approved/proposed decisions, evidence, assumptions and unknowns.
Specify the exact next action and required input/tool.
prohibited_behaviors: Use vague “continue where we left off.”
Omit material blockers or invent approvals.
